'''Fixer Seven''' was a [[Fixer (Imperial Intelligence)|Fixer]] within the [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. In [[3664 BBY]], Fixer Seven participated in [[Operation: Undertow]], along with [[Watcher X]]. Fixer Seven survived the operation, but sustained severe injuries in the process.
